ex.en: We have come to the conclusion that this plan is not feasible currently.
ex.zh: 我們的結論是，這個計畫目前不可行。

ex.en: Is it feasible to finish the project by Friday?
ex.zh: 星期五前完成這個專案可行嗎？

ex.en: We need a more feasible plan.
ex.zh: 我們需要一個更可行的計畫。

ex.en: Whatever you said to him made him feel better.
ex.zh: 不管你對他說了什麼，都讓他感覺好多了。

ex.en: When he feels fine, he goes for a walk.
ex.zh: 他心情好的時候就會去散步。

ex.en: For some reason I feel more alive at night.
ex.zh: 不知為何，我晚上比較有精神。

ex.en: I feel that we should wait.
ex.zh: 我覺得我們應該再等等。

ex.en: How do you feel about the new plan?
ex.zh: 你覺得新計畫怎麼樣？

ex.en: I don't feel like cooking tonight.
ex.zh: 我今晚不想煮飯。

ex.en: Do you feel like going for a walk?
ex.zh: 你想去散散步嗎？

ex.en: Feel how soft this blanket is.
ex.zh: 摸摸看這條毯子有多軟。

ex.en: The doctor felt my forehead.
ex.zh: 醫生摸了摸我的額頭。

ex.en: The rules must be few and, more importantly, simple.
ex.zh: 規則要少，更重要的是要簡單。

ex.en: Few people came to the meeting.
ex.zh: 來開會的人很少。

ex.en: Will you listen to me for a few minutes?
ex.zh: 你可以聽我說幾分鐘嗎？

ex.en: I have been reading this for a few hours.
ex.zh: 這個我已經讀了好幾個小時。

few.zh: quite a few / not a few：不少

ex.en: Not a few monkeys were found in the mountain.
ex.zh: 山裡發現了不少猴子。

ex.en: Quite a few employees work from home.
ex.zh: 不少員工在家工作。

ex.en: I don't want to live my life in fear.
ex.zh: 我不想活在恐懼中。

ex.en: Fear is more harmful than the sharpest of swords.
ex.zh: 恐懼比最鋒利的劍更傷人。

ex.en: The boy feared the dark.
ex.zh: 那個男孩怕黑。

ex.en: Many workers fear losing their jobs.
ex.zh: 許多員工擔心失業。

ex.en: It'd be best if a few more female singers could come.
ex.zh: 要是能多來幾位女歌手就最好了。

ex.en: Only sixteen percent of the teachers at the school are female.
ex.zh: 這所學校只有百分之十六的老師是女性。

ex.en: Athletic boys are very popular with American female students.
ex.zh: 運動型的男生很受美國女學生歡迎。

ex.en: Why are there differences between males and females?
ex.zh: 為什麼男性和女性之間會有差異？

ex.en: The female lays about ten eggs at a time.
ex.zh: 雌鳥一次大約會產十顆蛋。

ex.en: The Federal Republic of Germany was established in 1949.
ex.zh: 德意志聯邦共和國成立於 1949 年。

ex.en: Federal, state, and community officials immediately pledged to rebuild it.
ex.zh: 聯邦、州和地方官員立刻承諾會重建它。

ex.en: She works for the federal government.
ex.zh: 她在聯邦政府工作。

ex.en: I feed my cat every morning and every evening.
ex.zh: 我每天早晚餵我的貓。

ex.en: She is the one who feeds our dog.
ex.zh: 就是她在餵我們的狗。

ex.en: Tom had to remind Mary to feed the dog.
ex.zh: 湯姆得提醒瑪麗去餵狗。

ex.en: I'm fed up with him always preaching to me.
ex.zh: 我受夠了他老是對我說教。

ex.en: I'm fed up with working overtime every day.
ex.zh: 我受夠了每天加班。

ex.en: I saw your post in my news feed.
ex.zh: 我在動態消息上看到你的貼文。

ex.en: Her Instagram feed is full of food photos.
ex.zh: 她的 IG 動態全是美食照片。

fee.zh: 費用（入場費、學費、手續費等）

ex.en: There is no admission fee for children under five.
ex.zh: 五歲以下兒童免收入場費。

ex.en: How much is the monthly fee of this swimming school?
ex.zh: 這間游泳學校每個月的學費是多少？

ex.en: My travel fees to Japan are paid for by the university.
ex.zh: 我去日本的旅費由大學支付。

ex.en: He is hardly friendly with his fellow workers.
ex.zh: 他跟同事幾乎處不來。

ex.en: She is popular with her fellow students.
ex.zh: 她很受同學歡迎。

ex.en: He is a good fellow.
ex.zh: 他是個好人。

ex.en: Fred is a lazy fellow.
ex.zh: 弗雷德是個懶惰的傢伙。

ex.en: She was too short to see over the fence.
ex.zh: 她太矮了，看不到圍牆另一邊。

ex.en: Two children are sitting on top of the fence.
ex.zh: 兩個孩子坐在柵欄上。

ex.en: My father put a fence around the garden.
ex.zh: 我爸爸在花園四周裝了圍籬。

ex.en: The construction site was fenced off.
ex.zh: 工地被圍了起來。

ex.en: They fenced in the yard for their dog.
ex.zh: 他們為了狗把院子圍起來。

ex.en: The country's fertility rate has dropped sharply.
ex.zh: 這個國家的生育率大幅下降。

ex.en: She went to a clinic for fertility treatment.
ex.zh: 她去診所接受不孕症治療。

ex.en: Farmers add compost to improve soil fertility.
ex.zh: 農民加堆肥來提高土壤肥力。

ex.en: The valley is known for the fertility of its land.
ex.zh: 這座山谷以土地肥沃聞名。

ex.en: The doctor checked the fetal heartbeat.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查了胎兒的心跳。

ex.en: Smoking during pregnancy can harm fetal development.
ex.zh: 懷孕期間抽菸可能危害胎兒發育。

ex.en: The land on his farm is very fertile.
ex.zh: 他農場的土地非常肥沃。

ex.en: The soil here is fertile.
ex.zh: 這裡的土壤很肥沃。

ex.en: The animals are fertile at a young age.
ex.zh: 這些動物年紀很小就能繁殖。

ex.en: Some couples see a doctor to find out if they are fertile.
ex.zh: 有些夫妻會去看醫生，確認自己是否能生育。

ex.en: She has a very fertile imagination.
ex.zh: 她的想像力非常豐富。

ex.en: The meeting was fertile ground for new ideas.
ex.zh: 這場會議激盪出許多新點子。

ex.en: I have a fever and I ache all over.
ex.zh: 我發燒了，全身痠痛。

ex.en: I caught a cold, and I have a fever.
ex.zh: 我感冒了，還發燒。

ex.en: You have a little fever today, don't you?
ex.zh: 你今天是不是有點發燒？

ex.en: After weeks in bed, the old man was too feeble to walk.
ex.zh: 在床上躺了好幾週後，那位老先生虛弱得走不動。

ex.en: She gave a feeble cough and closed her eyes.
ex.zh: 她無力地咳了一聲，閉上了眼睛。

ex.en: That was a feeble excuse for being late.
ex.zh: 那是個站不住腳的遲到藉口。

ex.en: Spring Festival is also known as Chinese New Year.
ex.zh: 春節也就是農曆新年。

ex.en: Does the mid-autumn festival fall on Monday this year?
ex.zh: 今年中秋節是星期一嗎？

ex.en: A festival is held at the rice harvest.
ex.zh: 稻米收成時會舉辦慶典。

ex.en: We went to a music festival last summer.
ex.zh: 我們去年夏天去了一場音樂節。

ex.en: The film festival is held every October.
ex.zh: 這個影展每年十月舉辦。

ex.en: Waterproof features would be a plus.
ex.zh: 有防水功能會是加分。

ex.en: This app attracts over 10,000 users each day who engage with its features.
ex.zh: 這個 App 每天吸引超過一萬名使用者使用它的功能。

ex.en: It's not a bug, it's an undocumented feature.
ex.zh: 這不是一個漏洞，而是一個沒有寫進文件的特性。

ex.en: Featuring new music by Rihanna and more.
ex.zh: 收錄蕾哈娜等歌手的全新歌曲。

ex.en: The movie features a famous Taiwanese actor.
ex.zh: 這部電影由一位知名台灣演員主演。

ex.en: The hotel lobby looked festive with lanterns and flowers.
ex.zh: 飯店大廳掛上燈籠、擺上花卉，洋溢節慶氣氛。

ex.en: The staff wore festive colors for the holiday event.
ex.zh: 員工穿著應景色系服裝參加節慶活動。

ex.en: There were not more than one hundred passengers on board the ferry.
ex.zh: 渡輪上的乘客不超過一百人。

ex.en: We took the ferry to the island.
ex.zh: 我們搭渡輪去島上。

ex.en: The company welcomes feedback from consumers who use their products.
ex.zh: 公司歡迎使用產品的消費者提供回饋意見。

ex.en: Thanks for your feedback on my presentation.
ex.zh: 謝謝你對我簡報的回饋。

ex.en: We need to study the feasibility of the plan first.
ex.zh: 我們得先研究這個計畫的可行性。

ex.en: The feasibility report will be ready next week.
ex.zh: 可行性報告下週會完成。
